beats.text: 🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
👂 Overheard — A woman, maybe 60s: "That snare line needs checking. Talk later, work now."
📢 SYSTEM CHALLENGE: "Catch something! Anything! We want to see how you do it!" (Hunt an animal today for a reward.)
🩸 The Sweeps Week mauled Patrick (-51 health) over 4 rounds. They're lucky to be breathing.
"There's hurt to tend and bellies to fill. Triage for the hurt, rations to stretch what's left, or a hard hunt to replace what we lost."
(Relief is open — triage, rations, hunt, or rally, from the beats row. Each option works once; the moment passes in ~3 days.)
🩸 The Highbeam Deer mauled Meera (-49 health) over 2 rounds. They're lucky to be breathing.

Ruth watches for about thirty seconds, then takes pity on BOTH of you — you, and the trillion-eyed god taking notes. "Ruth shows you the real motions: heat, patience, restraint."

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and

📺 MID-SHOW — the feed cuts away from the game. A pod, huge on the screen. A small face behind the glass, asleep. The System, syrup-sweet: "Look at them! NAPPING! The audience wants to know — what should WE do with them? ...Well? You're the Bearer. SAY something. The cameras are RIGHT here."
Ruth is down by the firepit, nudging coals back into the middle.

Rich striped meat — cook it hard; this is the System's cut, not nature's. The fat burns long in a lamp. It's dead. The carcass is there on the ground — search the body if you want the meat. But you don't know this flesh. Clean it, test it cautiously, or ask someone who knows. And don't leave it long: meat rots where it lies.
"We can bind the wounds, or go lean, or hunt hard to replace what we lost. Say which — standing here isn't an answer."

👁 It dives the second it spooks and stays down longer than your nerve holds. Corner it away from the water, or trap the den mouth at dusk.
